usedFor: Gravitec.net delivers web push alerts through your Gravitec.net account, and “Send Push Notification” turns an event into one.

bestTemplate.name: “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo, then “Send Push Notification” in Gravitec.net
bestTemplate.why: An incoming message is a clear cue, and the action pushes a notice to your website subscribers.

watchOut: Push notifications reach people outside your business, so each one waits in Needs you for your approval.
